floors._note: One continuous public B1 passage level whose surveyed walking height varies 25.9-29.1 m TP; per-node z carries the real height.
Labelled 地上 from PLATEAU (plateau-ubld-13116, per sourceLabels): the open ground where the exit stairs end, at the PLATEAU closure surfaces on the stair tops.

summary.text: Routable (desk-verified against the PLATEAU 2023 survey geometry and official 2022/2026 maps; not field-verified; opening hours unknown): slice 1, the B1 Central Passage from the JR Central Gates east to Exits 27/34/35/36/37/42/43; slice 2, the passage along the JR east side to the South Passage east end and the south-east corridor to Exits 38/39/40/41; slice 3, the passage along the JR east side north to the North Passage (Exit 22, 東口（北）) and the passage between the Ikebukuro Shopping Park blocks to Exits 26/28/32/33; slice 4, the Central Passage west to the West Exit (西口) underground hall and its passages to Exits 10/11/15/17/18; slice 5, the South Passage west past the JR South Gate to the West Exit (South) hall (Exit 4, routed to the foot of its stairs, which are outside the survey) and the passage north to the West Exit hall. The rest of the PLATEAU B1 passage network is visible but not accessible (access unverified); access fences stop free walking there. Exits 4, 13 and 36 are routed only to the foot of their stairs; the stairs themselves are not part of the route. Fare-paid concourses and platforms are not modelled.

ルート案内対象（PLATEAU 2023年計測形状と公式案内図による机上検証。現地未確認、営業時間不明）：第1区画 中央通路（JR中央改札付近）から東側出口27・34・35・36・37・42・43；第2区画 JR東側通路から南通路東端、南東通路の出口38・39・40・41；第3区画 JR東側通路から北通路（出口22・東口（北））、池袋ショッピングパーク間の通路の出口26・28・32・33；第4区画 中央通路（西）から西口地下広場、出口10・11・15・17・18；第5区画 南通路（西）・JR南改札から西口（南）地下広場（出口4は計測範囲外の階段の下まで案内）、西口地下広場への通路。その他のB1地下通路は表示のみで立入不可（アクセス未確認のため、フェンスで進入を止めています）。出口4・13・36は階段の下までの案内で、階段自体はルートに含まれません。改札内・ホームは未モデル化。

missingFact.text: PLATEAU models only the lower flights of Exit 9 and of two stairwells near (-181, 126) and (-165, 113) (to TP ~30 m, street ~33 m). Exit 9's flight lies ~9 m from its map position; the (-181, 126) flight sits beside the wide stair to the Fukutoshin Line West Passage, and the (-165, 113) flight runs into the Hope Center block towards Exit 7's map position, so neither is matched. Exit 8's stairs lie at the west end of the passage, ~12 m beyond the surveyed floor. Exits 14, 16 and 19 (西口（中央）) have no stair in the survey. (Exit 13's lower flight matches its map position and is routed to its foot.)

計測データにあるのは、出口9と階段2か所の下側部分だけです（いずれも地上まで約3 m残ります）。出口9の階段は案内図の位置から約9 mずれています。階段の1か所は副都心線西通路へ向かう幅の広い階段の横にあり、もう1か所はホープセンターの区画の中へ、案内図の出口7の方向に延びているため、どちらも出口と対応づけられません。出口8の階段は通路の西端、計測された床から約12 m先にあります。出口14・16・19（西口（中央））は計測データに階段がありません（出口13の下側の階段は案内図の位置と一致するため、階段の下端まで案内しています）

derivationSummary.text: 国土数値情報（鉄道データ）から、駅周辺約700 mの駅と線路の形を切り出した表示です。名称や属性は含まず、地図上の目安としてのみ使い、経路には使いません。
Station and railway shapes within about 700 m, cut from Japan's National Land Numerical Information (railway data). No names or attributes; a rough map context only, never used for routing.

assets.derivation: PLATEAU CityGML LOD4.1 -> pipeline/extract_plateau_ubld.py (ENU) -> pipeline/blender_build_glb.py (triangulated, metric UV0); renderer frame (x, z, -y), identity transform; collision comes from per-mesh gteki_role tags (floor/stairs_ramps walkable; wall/barriers/transport collide), not from the asset role, because verified exit routes pass through door and portal panels; runtime variant assets/ikebukuro_b1_lit.glb (listed in files, not a second asset, so loaders that load every asset never stack both): the same geometry + generated ceiling LED fixtures (GTEki art direction, not surveyed) -> pipeline/blender_bake_lighting.py: second UV set (TEXCOORD_1) and a Cycles diffuse lightmap (assets/ikebukuro_b1_lightmap.webp / _2k.webp, gamma-2.2 encoded, scale in ikebukuro_b1_lit.meta.json). scene/scene.ts loads the lit variant and falls back to this GLB; kit/{high,low}/*.glb: Lane E kit pieces (see source gteki-kit-0-1-0) copied unmodified by pipeline/sync_kit.py and instanced by scene/kit.ts on the access-fence label stretches and, for the two column pieces, by scene/kit_columns.ts as sleeves on the PLATEAU column footprints in scene/columns.json (finish generic, not surveyed), visual only, no colliders; gteki_gate_array_2 (kit/{high,low}/): ONE generic array per node at g_jr_c1, g_jr_c2 and g_jr_s, anchored on the node with its aisles along the verified edge's arriving direction, visual only, no colliders, not in the walk graph. 「代表性擺設，通道數與方向未驗證」 / "representative placement; aisle count and orientation unverified": the aisle count, direction and side are guesses, not a surveyed layout; scene/kit_signs.ts stretches the generic sign frame around the existing sign faces; presentation only, never walkable or colliders

derivationSummary.text: 国土交通省 PLATEAU の地下街3Dモデルを加工して作成した、池袋駅地下1階の表示です。照明（明暗も表示用に計算したもの）、改札機の並び、柱の仕上げ、案内板の枠などは GTEki が表示用に加えたもので、実際の位置や数を測ったものではありません。経路には使いません。

Ikebukuro Station's B1 floor, made by modifying the PLATEAU (MLIT) 3D model of the underground area. Lights (and their computed shading), ticket-gate rows, column finishes and sign frames are GTEki additions for display; their positions and counts were not surveyed. Never used for routing.

assets.derivation: PLATEAU bldg (LOD1 low / LOD2 high) and tran (road geometry only) -> tools/gis: `gis context-glb ikebukuro --variant low --merge tiles:380` (assets/ikebukuro_context_low.glb, 8 meshes, 30,418 tris; receipt docs/gis/context/context-ikebukuro-r250-x120-ikebukuro-station-enu-v0-low-tiles380-daebc9ca51cbeea3c90a.json) and `gis context-glb ikebukuro --variant high --merge tiles:380` (assets/ikebukuro_context_high.glb, 8 meshes, 139,525 tris; receipt docs/gis/context/context-ikebukuro-r250-x120-ikebukuro-station-enu-v0-high-tiles380-015891c342423501b9d1.json); the high file is listed in files, not a second asset, so loaders that load every asset never stack both. Committed bytes equal the receipts: ikebukuro_context_low.glb sha256 0629b00cf18a57f816d341c871052fd19f835e39ffdfc445058a216346d5487c (2,266,864 B), ikebukuro_context_high.glb sha256 ad55b6da91ae7c8960db789cc6e654043735736bbf5e813f904c15a6519dcdb6 (9,488,428 B). Station ENU frame, TP heights, whole features, no textures, no tran attributes. Roads ship as geometry only under the Owner's risk acceptance (docs/gis/decisions/2026-10-22-plateau-tran-geometry-risk-acceptance.md). Every node is gteki_role=context, named ctx_bldg_* or ctx_road_*, NOT_FOR_ROUTING, visual_only: never walkable, never a collider, never a camera blocker. scene/scene.ts loads the variant matching ctx.quality in the background and shows it only when the camera is near street level.

derivationSummary.text: 国土交通省 PLATEAU の建物と道路の形（テクスチャなし）を使った、駅周辺の3D表示です。名称や属性は含まず、表示専用で、経路には使いません。
A 3D view of the buildings and roads around the station, using PLATEAU (MLIT) building and road shapes without textures. No names or attributes; for display only, never used for routing.

dataFiles.derivation: pipeline/build_signage.py: sign positions, facing and arrows from verified edge geometry and routing (gteki/graph.json); placement against PLATEAU ceiling and wall surfaces (build/ubld_enu.json), with continuous 6-10 m full-face sight-line envelopes from the 1.62 m walker eye and default follow camera against the shipped lit GLB walls/ceiling/barriers/light_fixtures and scene/columns.json kit sleeves (nearest clear candidate, otherwise retained and reported blocked); exit and gate names/labels from gteki/pois.json (names only, no source sign layout reproduced). sourceIds = every verified edge's geometry/access evidence and its end nodes' sourceRefs, plus the evidence of each exit and gate a sign shows (a wide set)

pipeline/build_station.py crowd_lanes(): per verified edge (gteki/graph.json geometry), the lateral width a pedestrian may stand off the polyline, sampled on the PLATEAU walkable grid (build/ubld_enu.json, >= 0.35 m from walls) inside the routable coverage areas (data/graph.src.json). sourceIds = PLATEAU, the routable areas' sources and every verified edge's geometry/access evidence and end nodes' sourceRefs (a wide set)

pipeline/build_walkfix.py: thin invisible quads bridging hairline cracks (< 0.30 m, same height within 0.06 m) between adjacent PLATEAU floor and stair-tread polygons (build/ubld_enu.json); they change neither the graph nor the rendered geometry

pipeline/build_access.py: fence pieces and 'access unverified' label stretches along the outline of the routable coverage areas (data/graph.src.json) where PLATEAU floor (build/ubld_enu.json) lies beside it; verified edge geometry (gteki/graph.json) is only checked for clearance and does not shape the output. sourceIds = PLATEAU and the routable areas' sources
GTEki-authored finish-pack config (role → texture folder + repeat in metres); empty today; no external source

GTEki-authored kit placement config (which library pieces the scene places, their use, pitch and the representative gate-array label); the pieces themselves are assets[] files (gteki/kit/**); no external source

pipeline/extract_columns.py: PLATEAU column footprints and heights found by shape in the barriers triangles (build/ubld_enu.json, welded vertical prisms 1.5 m or taller, up to 3 m across), each with its kit sleeve piece id or null and a reason. sourceIds = PLATEAU

pipeline/build_identity.py: GTEki-authored board placements fitted to shipped PLATEAU ceilings/walls with fittings excluded from Sightlines; station/transfer facts from OSM and approximate meeting-point facts from reference-only sources. NOT_FOR_ROUTING.
